nodes.summary: A function $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ is a linear threshold function if there are reals $w_0, w_1, \dots, w_n$ such that for every $x \in \{-1, 1\}^n$ we have $f(x) = \operatorname{sgn}(w_0 + w_1 x_1 + \dots + w_n x_n)$, where $x_i \in \{-1, 1\}$ is the $i$-th coordinate of $x$, $\operatorname{sgn} z = 1$ for $z \ge 0$ and $\operatorname{sgn} z = -1$ for $z < 0$.
nodes.title: Linear threshold function

nodes.summary: For every odd natural number $n \ge 5$, the Majority Is Least Stable conjecture in $n$ variables fails: there are a linear threshold function $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ and a real number $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$ such that $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho[f] < \mathrm{Stab}_\rho[\mathrm{Maj}_n]$, where $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho$ is the noise stability and $\mathrm{Maj}_n$ is the majority function.
nodes.title: Majority Is Least Stable fails in every odd dimension at least five

nodes.summary: There is an odd natural number $n \ge 5$ for which the Majority Is Least Stable conjecture in $n$ variables holds: every linear threshold function $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho[f] \ge \mathrm{Stab}_\rho[\mathrm{Maj}_n]$ for every real $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$, where $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho$ is the noise stability and $\mathrm{Maj}_n$ is the majority function.
nodes.title: Majority Is Least Stable in some odd dimension at least five

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, this is the statement that every linear threshold function $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho[f] \ge \mathrm{Stab}_\rho[\mathrm{Maj}_n]$ for every real $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$, where $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho$ is the noise stability and $\mathrm{Maj}_n$ is the majority function.
nodes.title: Majority Is Least Stable conjecture in $n$ variables

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the majority function $\mathrm{Maj}_n : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ is given by $\mathrm{Maj}_n(x) = 1$ if $x_1 + \dots + x_n \ge 0$ and $\mathrm{Maj}_n(x) = -1$ otherwise, where $x_i \in \{-1, 1\}$ is the $i$-th coordinate of $x$.
nodes.title: Majority function

nodes.summary: For a real number $\rho$ and a function $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, the noise stability of $f$ at $\rho$ is $\mathrm{Stab}_\rho[f] = \sum_{S \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}} \rho^{|S|} \hat f(S)^2$, where $\hat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
nodes.title: Noise stability

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.
